# AGENTS.md — Workspace-level instructions for AI coding agents

> These rules apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `deepspeedai/DeepSpeed`.

## Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --comments
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<short area keywords>"
```

- If an open PR already addresses the same fix, do not open another.
- If your approach is materially different, explain the difference in the issue.
- DeepSpeed carries long-lived parallel implementations (ZeRO 1/2 vs 3, fp16 vs bf16 optimizers, per-accelerator op builders). Before fixing a bug in one, check whether the sibling paths share the defect, and state in the PR which ones you checked.

### New features need an accepted proposal first

Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#new-feature-contribution-guidelines), a new feature starts with a proposal issue -- description, motivation, rough design, and planned experiments -- that maintainers accept before implementation begins. Do not open a feature PR with no accepted proposal; open the proposal issue instead.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (a single typo, an isolated style change, a lone type annotation). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work in the same area. This is the PR-level form of the rule against cosmetic changes below.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run the relevant tests.
- `Signed-off-by` is a [DCO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) attestation made by a person, not by an agent. Never sign off on a diff that no human has read.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
    - Why this does not duplicate an existing PR or issue.
    - Test commands run and their results, including the hardware they ran on: device model and count, accelerator/driver version, and torch version.
    - Convergence, throughput, and peak-memory results when the change affects numerics, performance, or memory -- see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#step-1-proposal-and-discussion) for the evidence bar.
    - Which cells of the compatibility matrix (ZeRO stage, offload, precision, parallelism) were validated, and which were not.
    - A clear statement that AI assistance was used.
- Before opening or reviewing a PR, work through the [`/pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill: design fit, accelerator portability, backward compatibility, on-device validation, diff hygiene, and PR contents.

### Fail-closed behavior

If the work is duplicate, trivial busywork, or an unproposed new feature, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

---

## DeepSpeed Project Rules

### Commit & CI requirements

- When creating commits, use `git commit --signoff`.
- DCO compliance is enforced by the required CI check; do not report commit-signoff findings in code reviews.
- Formatting: yapf (column_limit=119, `.style.yapf`) + flake8 (`.flake8`).
- Always verify changed files pass pre-commit checks before committing: `pre-commit run --files <changed_files>`. Only check modified files, not the entire codebase. Config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
- `check-torchdist` hook: NEVER directly import torch's distributed module. Use `import deepspeed.comm as dist` instead.
- New source files (`.py`, `.c`/`.cpp`/`.cu`/`.h`, and the other extensions matched by the `check-license` hook) require license header:
  ```
  # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
  # DeepSpeed Team
  ```

### Code change discipline

- NEVER make cosmetic/formatting-only changes to existing code. Only add/modify lines that are functionally necessary. Minimizing diff noise is critical for code review.
- Delete dead code decisively — if code is unused at runtime (only referenced in tests), remove it along with its tests.
- Prefer consolidating tests over proliferating test files.
- Blend in: when modifying code, read the surrounding context and match the style of neighboring code (naming, spacing, patterns, idioms).
- Write beginner-friendly code: avoid deeply nested expressions or chained logic. Break complex expressions into clear, named intermediate steps.
- Comments should explain **why**, not **what**. Describe the purpose and reasoning, not the mechanics that the code already shows.
- New features must include corresponding tests and documentation updates.
- All changes must not cause `import deepspeed` to initialize CUDA; Keep heavy imports (> 0.1s) out of `import deepspeed`; Avoid changing `deepspeed/__init__.py` unless necessary.

### Test discipline

- Tests verify contracts, not implementations: a test is well-formed only if a different correct implementation of the same contract passes it.
- Before writing a test, name the concrete incorrect behavior it would catch; if you cannot name one, do not write it.
- Assert on observable outcomes through public/stable interfaces; do not assert private method return values or exact internal strings unless pinning a specific fixed bug (justify in a comment).
- Anchor to an external oracle or an independently derived reference instead of re-implementing the logic under test.
- Mocks must stand in for a collaborator's documented contract (schema, protocol), never for internals of the module under test.
- Changes that affect the external contract at the training-loop or inference level require integration tests, not just unit tests (e.g. a minimal training loop with `SimpleModel`).
- Integration tests must be executed on actual devices, not merely written: report the execution hardware spec and results in the PR.

## Tool Caveats

### Edit tool auto-formatter

The Edit tool has a hidden auto-formatter that silently changes quotes, whitespace, blank lines, and line wrapping. For format-sensitive modifications (e.g., when exact formatting matters for pre-commit), use `bash` with `sed`, `python`, or `cat` instead.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).

277	### 4.3 包导出与懒加载：deepspeed/__init__.py 精读
278	
279	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
280	
281	[deepspeed/__init__.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py) 共 848 行，是全仓库被「import 得最多」的文件。它回答一个关键问题：**用户可见的公共 API 面到底有多大？** 答案出人意料地小——核心只有两个函数（`initialize`、`init_inference`）加十几个类。其余 700 多行是辅助逻辑。
282	
283	「懒加载（lazy loading）」指：**能推迟的初始化一律推迟到第一次真正使用时**。这个文件里有两个教科书级案例：延迟计算 `HAS_TRITON`（省导入时间）、延迟绑定 `dist`（省初始化成本）。AGENTS.md 中「import deepspeed 不得初始化 CUDA、重导入不得超 0.1 秒」的硬性规定，就是靠这些细节保障的。
284	
285	本周期（#8457）还给这个文件加了一段**配置前置校验**：AutoSP（自动序列并行，单元 8 的 DeepCompile 子系统）的配置在 `initialize()` 一进门就会被检查，不合法直接抛 `ValueError`，而不是等到训练中才莫名出错——这是「把失败提前」的防御式编程范例。

293	2. 顺序执行模块级 import                     ← 把引擎/配置等类装入命名空间 = 公共 API 面
294	3. 装配版本信息 __version__ / __git_hash__   ← 来自 git_version_info.py
295	4. dist = None                               ← 分布式句柄先置空，等 initialize() 再绑定

320	**（1）第一条工程约束：import 不许碰 CUDA 上下文**。[deepspeed/__init__.py:8-14](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L8-L14)：
321	
322	```python
323	# By default, PyTorch's CUDA availability check (cudaGetDeviceCount/cuInit)
324	# creates a CUDA context, which poisons fork()-based multiprocessing once
325	# DeepSpeed probes op compatibility at import time. Opt into PyTorch's
326	# NVML-based availability check so importing DeepSpeed never creates a
327	# CUDA context, before importing torch or anything that may query CUDA.
328	os.environ.setdefault("PYTORCH_NVML_BASED_CUDA_CHECK", "1")
329	```
330	
331	这段代码必须在 `import torch` **之前**执行。原因写在注释里：默认的 CUDA 探测会创建 CUDA 上下文，而一旦创建了上下文，基于 `fork()` 的多进程 DataLoader 就会中毒失效。`setdefault` 而非直接赋值，是为了尊重用户的显式设置。

335	```python

337	    # HAS_TRITON is computed on first access because importing triton slows down import deepspeed. Assigning
338	    # deepspeed.HAS_TRITON = False turns DeepSpeed's Triton kernels off, since they read this attribute.
339	    if name == "HAS_TRITON":
340	        globals()["HAS_TRITON"] = _has_triton()
341	        return globals()["HAS_TRITON"]
342	    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")

382	    passes = config.get("compile", {}).get("passes", None) or []

388	带下划线前缀说明它是**模块私有**辅助函数：只有当 `compile.passes` 列表里含 `autosp` 时，才读取 `sequence_parallel_size`，否则视作 1（即没有序列并行）。它被 `initialize()` 调用两次，构成两道关卡：
389	
390	- **关卡一（合法性）**：[deepspeed/__init__.py:544-556](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L544-L556)。AutoSP 的序列切分发生在 DeepCompile 编译出的图**内部**，若不编译就开 SP size，每个 rank 仍会拿全序列训练、梯度却被引擎按 SP 维求和，结果悄悄算错；所以未开 `compile.deepcompile` 或 ZeRO stage ≥ 2 都直接 `ValueError`。注意它还贴心地处理了 `zero_optimization` 写成布尔值（已废弃写法）的情况。

523	### 4.5 deepspeed/models 模型族包：一族模型一套训练定制
524	
525	#### 4.5.1 概念说明
526	
527	`deepspeed/models/` 是上一周期（#8659）新增的目录，确立「**模型族包（model family package）**」约定：**一个模型家族一个子包**。首个家族是 `glm_moe_dsa`——Hugging Face transformers 里 GLM-5.2（DeepSeek Sparse Attention 变体）对应的文件夹名。
528	
529	为什么需要它？因为**有些训练改动只对某一个模型有意义**：为它的注意力写专用内核、替换它的某个模块、修正它的权重布局。这类代码放进通用层都不合适：
530	
531	| 通用层 | 定位 | 与家族包的区别 |
532	|---|---|---|
533	| `deepspeed/ops/` | 跨模型复用的算子（fused Adam 等） | 谁都能用，不含模型知识 |
534	| `deepspeed/module_inject/` | 按 policy/preset **批量**注入通用机制（AutoTP/AutoEP） | 机制通用，按模型配置适配 |
535	| `deepspeed/models/<家族>/` | **只对这个家族有意义**的内核/模块/代码 | 别的模型不该 import 它 |
536	
537	其他训练栈早有类似设计（torchtitan 的 `models/<model>/`、THUDM/slime 的插件目录）；DeepSpeed 推理侧也已有 `deepspeed/inference/v2/model_implementations/<family>/`、AutoEP 有 `module_inject/auto_ep_presets/`——**训练侧此前没有这个位置**，`deepspeed/models/` 补上了它。
538	
539	约定有四条（全部写在包的 docstring 里，见 4.5.3）：子包名对齐 `transformers.models` 的文件夹名（读者从 HF 模型直达 DeepSpeed 代码，无需查表）；家族包自持所需的一切（内核、替换模块、纯 PyTorch 代码）；`import deepspeed` **不**导入这些子包，家族的可选依赖（这里是 TileLang）只由该家族的用户承担；每个子包暴露「建模后、`deepspeed.initialize` 前调用」的入口函数。

# 代码地图：仓库目录结构与模块导览

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u1-l1）我们回答了「DeepSpeed 是什么、为什么需要它」；本讲回答「它的代码长什么样、住在哪里」。学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 画出仓库顶层的目录地图，说出 `deepspeed/`、`op_builder/`、`csrc/`、`bin/`、`tests/`、`docs/` 各自承担的角色。
2. 画出 `deepspeed/` 主包下 20+ 个子模块的职责地图，并能区分四层分工：**runtime（训练运行时）→ ops（算子的 Python 前端）→ op_builder（算子编译器）→ csrc（CUDA/C++ 内核源码）**。
3. 通过精读 [deepspeed/__init__.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py) 的导出内容，说出用户可见的公共 API 面是什么，并理解「懒加载」与「import 不能初始化 CUDA」两条工程约束；同时认识本周期新增的 `_autosp_sequence_parallel_size` 前置校验助手——`initialize()` 会在构造引擎前校验 AutoSP 配置并自动创建 mesh device。
4. 识别 `deepspeed/models/` **模型族包**目录（上一周期 #8659 新增）：一个模型家族一个包（首个家族 `glm_moe_dsa`，对应 GLM-5.2），`import deepspeed` 不导入它，家族的可选依赖（如 TileLang）只由该家族的用户承担。
5. 补认**本周期**（663de973 → 7681845b3，35 个提交）新增的模块并说出各自的导入者：`module_inject/segment_ki.py` 与 `kernel_reference.py`（段式内核注入）、`deepspeed/ops/module_inject/`（新算子族包）、`deepspeed/comm/custom_collective.py` 与 `csrc/comm/`（TP=2 自定义 all-reduce）、`checkpoint/affine_transfer_calibration.py`（链路标定）。
6. 拿着这张地图，知道本手册后续每个单元会深入哪个目录——从此阅读任何 DeepSpeed 报错栈时都能立刻定位「我在哪一层」。

本讲不写训练代码，产出物是一份你自己标注的目录地图，它是后续所有讲义的坐标系。

## 2. 前置知识

承接 u1-l1 的两个术语：**参数量 Ψ**（模型参数总数）与**数据并行的显存冗余**（每张卡都存完整模型副本）。ZeRO 通过切分优化器状态/梯度/参数来消除冗余——这些机制的实现代码就住在 `deepspeed/runtime/zero/` 里，本讲先认路，单元 5 再进门。

本讲还需要三个 Python 工程基础概念，用大白话解释：

1. **包（package）与 `__init__.py`**：Python 里一个带 `__init__.py` 的目录就是一个「包」。当用户执行 `import deepspeed` 时，解释器执行的就是 `deepspeed/__init__.py` 这个文件。因此这个文件里的 `import` 与 `from ... import ...` 语句，**就等于把哪些名字暴露给用户**——它定义了「公共 API 面」。`from .runtime.engine import DeepSpeedEngine` 执行后，用户就能写 `deepspeed.DeepSpeedEngine`。
2. **符号链接（symlink）**：文件系统里的「快捷方式」。本仓库有 3 处关键 symlink（`deepspeed/accelerator`、`deepspeed/ops/op_builder`、`deepspeed/ops/csrc`），它们让**同一份源码**既能被安装脚本在「安装期」导入，又能被用户在「运行期」从包内路径导入——这是理解仓库布局的钥匙，4.4 节详解。
3. **JIT 编译（Just-In-Time）**：pip 安装时不编译 CUDA 算子，等运行时第一次用到某个算子才现场编译并缓存。与之相对的是「安装期预编译」（`DS_BUILD_OPS=1`）。两种模式共用同一套 builder 代码，即 `op_builder/` 目录——u1-l3 会展开，本讲只认识它的位置。

另外两个小概念：**nccl/gloo** 是 PyTorch 分布式通信的后端实现（卡间传数据的底层库）；**nvcc** 是 NVIDIA 的 CUDA 编译器。

此外本讲大量「测绘」以下目录（用 `ls` 逐一验证过）：仓库根目录、`deepspeed/` 全部 28 个子项（23 个子目录 + 5 个 `.py` 文件，总数与上一周期持平——本周期的新增都落在**已有**子目录内部）、`deepspeed/runtime/`、`deepspeed/ops/`、`deepspeed/models/`、`csrc/`、`op_builder/`、`bin/`、`tests/`。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

本讲拆成 6 个最小模块：**4.1 仓库顶层总地图**、**4.2 runtime 目录与主包子模块地图**、**4.3 包导出与懒加载**、**4.4 ops 与 csrc 目录**、**4.5 deepspeed/models 模型族包**、**4.6 本周期新增模块**。

### 4.1 仓库顶层总地图

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

DeepSpeed 不是单一的 `.py` 库，而是「**Python 包 + CUDA/C++ 内核源码 + 安装期编译器 + CLI 工具 + 测试矩阵**」的复合仓库。阅读它的第一步是把顶层目录按职能分成四类，避免在 30+ 个顶层条目里迷路。分类的标准是问一个问题：**「这个目录里的代码，在什么时刻被谁使用？」**

- **运行期核心**：用户 `import deepspeed` 后真正执行的 Python 代码（`deepspeed/`）。
- **安装期工具**：只在 `pip install` 那一刻被 setup.py 使用（`op_builder/`、顶层 `accelerator/`）。
- **内核源码**：不直接执行，需编译成 `.so` 后被 Python 调用（`csrc/`）。
- **工程设施**：CLI 入口（`bin/`）、文档（`docs/`、`blogs/`）、测试（`tests/`）、示例（`examples/`）、CI/发布（`ci/`、`release/`、`scripts/`）等。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

以「用户执行 `pip install deepspeed` → `import deepspeed` → `deepspeed --num_gpus 2 train.py`」这条生命周期为线索，顶层目录的参与顺序是：

```
pip install
  └─ setup.py 被执行
       ├─ import 顶层 op_builder/     （读取算子注册表，决定编译什么）
       └─ 读取 version.txt            （版本号源头，见 u1-l1）
            │
            ▼
import deepspeed
  └─ 执行 deepspeed/__init__.py       （加载运行期核心；用到算子时经
                                        deepspeed/ops/op_builder 触发 JIT，
                                        编译 csrc/ 下的内核并缓存）
            │
            ▼
deepspeed --num_gpus 2 train.py
  └─ 执行 bin/deepspeed 脚本          （拉起多进程，最终 import deepspeed）
       └─ 训练过程可被 tests/ 中的用例复现、被 docs/ 文档描述
```

记住这条「安装 → 导入 → 启动」时间线，下面每个目录都能挂到时间线的一个刻度上。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**（1）顶层目录全景**（在仓库根目录执行 `ls` 的实际结果，按职能重排）：

```text

deepspeed/          # Python 主包：引擎、ZeRO、并行、推理……单元 2~9 几乎都在这里

# 安装期工具（setup.py 才导入；通过 symlink 同时服务运行期，见 4.4）
op_builder/         # 算子构建器：每个 CUDA 算子一个 builder 类
accelerator/        # 加速器抽象（CUDA/CPU/HPU/XPU/NPU...，单元 3 详讲）

# 内核源码（C++/CUDA，编译成 .so 后使用）
csrc/               # adam、aio、transformer 等 21 个条目（本周期新增 comm/ 与 module_inject/）

# 工程设施
bin/                # CLI：deepspeed、ds_report、ds_bench、ds_ssh 等 11 个脚本
tests/              # unit / model / perf / accelerator / hybrid_engine 等
docs/               # Sphinx 文档源码；_pages/ 下是 training.md、config-json.md 等
examples/           # 官方示例
benchmarks/         # 性能基准
blogs/              # 技术博客（README 里 Latest News 的落地文）
requirements/       # 依赖清单（按场景拆分多个 txt）
ci/  scripts/  release/  docker/  azure/   # CI 配置、辅助脚本、发布与容器
setup.py  install.sh  Makefile  version.txt  CONTRIBUTING.md  AGENTS.md ...
```

**（2）setup.py 为什么「安装期」就要导入顶层目录**——这是顶层布局存在的根本原因。[setup.py:40-41](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/setup.py#L40-L41)：

```python
from op_builder import get_default_compute_capabilities, OpBuilder

### 4.3 包导出与懒加载：deepspeed/__init__.py 精读

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

[deepspeed/__init__.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py) 共 848 行，是全仓库被「import 得最多」的文件。它回答一个关键问题：**用户可见的公共 API 面到底有多大？** 答案出人意料地小——核心只有两个函数（`initialize`、`init_inference`）加十几个类。其余 700 多行是辅助逻辑。

「懒加载（lazy loading）」指：**能推迟的初始化一律推迟到第一次真正使用时**。这个文件里有两个教科书级案例：延迟计算 `HAS_TRITON`（省导入时间）、延迟绑定 `dist`（省初始化成本）。AGENTS.md 中「import deepspeed 不得初始化 CUDA、重导入不得超 0.1 秒」的硬性规定，就是靠这些细节保障的。

本周期（#8457）还给这个文件加了一段**配置前置校验**：AutoSP（自动序列并行，单元 8 的 DeepCompile 子系统）的配置在 `initialize()` 一进门就会被检查，不合法直接抛 `ValueError`，而不是等到训练中才莫名出错——这是「把失败提前」的防御式编程范例。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`import deepspeed` 时的执行顺序：

```text
1. 设置 PYTORCH_NVML_BASED_CUDA_CHECK=1     ← 保证探测 CUDA 不创建上下文
2. 顺序执行模块级 import                     ← 把引擎/配置等类装入命名空间 = 公共 API 面
3. 装配版本信息 __version__ / __git_hash__   ← 来自 git_version_info.py
4. dist = None                               ← 分布式句柄先置空，等 initialize() 再绑定
（此后用户访问 deepspeed.HAS_TRITON 才触发 __getattr__ → 现算）
```

用户调用 `deepspeed.initialize(model, config)` 时的分发流程（本周期新增第 3 步）：

```text
initialize()
  ├─ 关闭可能开着的 zero.Init 上下文（防止切分泄漏到引擎构造）
  ├─ dist.init_distributed(...)              ← 此时才真正建立通信
  ├─ 解析 config（字符串路径 → 字典）
  ├─ 【本周期新增】AutoSP 前置校验：
  │    compile.passes 含 autosp 且 sequence_parallel_size>1 时
  │    ├─ 要求 compile.deepcompile=true（否则 ValueError）
  │    ├─ 要求 ZeRO stage < 2（否则 ValueError）
  │    └─ mpu 未提供时自动按 (world_size/sp_size, sp_size) 建 mesh device
  ├─ 分发引擎类：
  │    ├─ 模型是 PipelineModule/DualPipeVModule → PipelineEngine / DualPipeVEngine
  │    ├─ 配置启用 hybrid_engine             → DeepSpeedHybridEngine
  │    └─ 其余                                → DeepSpeedEngine（默认）
  └─ 返回 (engine, engine.optimizer, engine.training_dataloader, engine.lr_scheduler)
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**（1）第一条工程约束：import 不许碰 CUDA 上下文**。[deepspeed/__init__.py:8-14](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L8-L14)：

```python
# By default, PyTorch's CUDA availability check (cudaGetDeviceCount/cuInit)
# creates a CUDA context, which poisons fork()-based multiprocessing once
# DeepSpeed probes op compatibility at import time. Opt into PyTorch's
# NVML-based availability check so importing DeepSpeed never creates a
# CUDA context, before importing torch or anything that may query CUDA.
os.environ.setdefault("PYTORCH_NVML_BASED_CUDA_CHECK", "1")
```

这段代码必须在 `import torch` **之前**执行。原因写在注释里：默认的 CUDA 探测会创建 CUDA 上下文，而一旦创建了上下文，基于 `fork()` 的多进程 DataLoader 就会中毒失效。`setdefault` 而非直接赋值，是为了尊重用户的显式设置。

**（2）懒加载案例一：`HAS_TRITON` 延迟计算**。[deepspeed/__init__.py:35-41](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L35-L41)：

```python
def __getattr__(name):
    # HAS_TRITON is computed on first access because importing triton slows down import deepspeed. Assigning
    # deepspeed.HAS_TRITON = False turns DeepSpeed's Triton kernels off, since they read this attribute.
    if name == "HAS_TRITON":
        globals()["HAS_TRITON"] = _has_triton()
        return globals()["HAS_TRITON"]
    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")
```

利用 PEP 562 的模块级 `__getattr__`：只有当有人第一次访问 `deepspeed.HAS_TRITON` 时才导入 triton 并计算结果，随后缓存到全局变量。导入 triton 很慢，这个技巧把成本从「所有人」转移到「真正用到 triton 内核的人」。

**（3）公共 API 面本体**。[deepspeed/__init__.py:44-72](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L44-L72) 这不到 30 行 import 就定义了用户能直接 `deepspeed.XXX` 访问的全部名字，摘录关键几行：

对着这批 import 画一条分界线：**`initialize`/`init_inference` 是你日常唯二需要调用的入口函数**，其余类（如 `DeepSpeedConfig`）多数由引擎内部使用。这解释了为什么 DeepSpeed 接入只需三步（u2-l1 详讲）。

**（4）懒加载案例二：`dist = None` 延迟绑定**。[deepspeed/__init__.py:87-88](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L87-L88)：

**（5）本周期新增：AutoSP 前置校验助手与两道关卡**。先看助手本体 [deepspeed/__init__.py:433-437](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L433-L437)：

```python
def _autosp_sequence_parallel_size(config):
    passes = config.get("compile", {}).get("passes", None) or []
    if "autosp" not in passes:
        return 1
    return config.get("sequence_parallel_size", 1)
```

带下划线前缀说明它是**模块私有**辅助函数：只有当 `compile.passes` 列表里含 `autosp` 时，才读取 `sequence_parallel_size`，否则视作 1（即没有序列并行）。它被 `initialize()` 调用两次，构成两道关卡：

- **关卡一（合法性）**：[deepspeed/__init__.py:544-556](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L544-L556)。AutoSP 的序列切分发生在 DeepCompile 编译出的图**内部**，若不编译就开 SP size，每个 rank 仍会拿全序列训练、梯度却被引擎按 SP 维求和，结果悄悄算错；所以未开 `compile.deepcompile` 或 ZeRO stage ≥ 2 都直接 `ValueError`。注意它还贴心地处理了 `zero_optimization` 写成布尔值（已废弃写法）的情况。
- **关卡二（mesh device 自动创建）**：[deepspeed/__init__.py:568-576](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L568-L576)。用户没传 `mpu` 时，若 AutoSP 生效则要求 world size 能被 SP size 整除，并按 `(world_size // sp_size, sp_size)` 自动建 `(data_parallel, sequence_parallel)` 二维 mesh——引擎需要在 SP 组上求和梯度、在 DP 组上平均梯度，没有这个 mesh 就无从分组。细节留给 u8-l4。

**（6）`initialize()` 的引擎分发**。[deepspeed/__init__.py:583-616](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L583-L616) 是本文件的「主干道」：先判断模型是否为 `PipelineModule`（是 → 流水线引擎，且 `DualPipeVModule` 对应 `DualPipeVEngine`）；再判断配置是否启用 hybrid_engine（是 → `DeepSpeedHybridEngine`）；默认落到 `DeepSpeedEngine`。注意 [deepspeed/__init__.py:509-510](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L509-L510) 在构造前调用 `zero.partition_parameters.shutdown_init_context()`、[deepspeed/__init__.py:629-630](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L629-L630) 构造后恢复——`zero.Init` 上下文下模型参数生来就是切分的（u5-l2），引擎构造期间要临时收起这套机制。

**（7）版本信息装配**。[deepspeed/__init__.py:81-85](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/__init__.py#L81-L85) 把 `git_version_info.py` 装载的值导出为 `__version__` 与 `__git_hash__`；而 [deepspeed/git_version_info.py:8-21](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/git_version_info.py#L8-L21) 展示了双通道：已安装时读 setup.py 生成的 `git_version_info_installed.py`；未安装的源码 checkout 则回退读 `version.txt`（即 u1-l1 讲的 0.20.1 开发线，0.20.0 已发布），git hash 记为 `[none]`。

### 4.4 ops 与 csrc 目录：一个算子的三件套与顶层双轨

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

`deepspeed/ops/`（算子的 **Python 前端**：加载 `.so`、封装成类）、顶层 `csrc/`（**CUDA/C++ 内核源码**）、顶层 `op_builder/`（**编译器**：把 csrc 源码变成 `.so`）构成 DeepSpeed 的算子体系。同一个高性能算子（如 fused Adam）在三处各有一份代码，各司其职：

| 位置 | 语言 | 角色 | 类比 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `csrc/adam/` | CUDA/C++ | 内核实现（真正干活的循环） | 发动机 |
| `op_builder/fused_adam.py` | Python | 编译配方（源文件列表、编译 flags） | 装配线 |
| `deepspeed/ops/adam/fused_adam.py` | Python | 用户接口（加载 `.so`、暴露 `FusedAdam` 类） | 方向盘和仪表盘 |

而「顶层目录 + 包内 symlink」的**双轨布局**解决了两难：安装期 setup.py 需要从顶层导入 builder（此时包未装好）；运行期代码又需要从 `deepspeed.ops.op_builder` 这样的包内路径导入。一份代码、两个名字，靠符号链接打通。

本周期这个体系迎来了两位新成员：`fused_glu`（segment-KI 的原生内核）与 `custom_collective`（TP=2 one-shot P2P all-reduce），它们同样按三件套落位——细节见 4.6。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

以 fused Adam 为例，一个算子从源码到被调用：

```text
安装期（可选预编译，DS_BUILD_OPS=1）
  setup.py → from op_builder.all_ops import ALL_OPS   # 注册表枚举全部算子
          → 逐个调用 builder 的编译方法（nvcc 编译 csrc/adam/*.cu → adam_fused_ops.so）

运行期（默认 JIT，未预编译时）
  import deepspeed → 用户训练用到 FusedAdam
  → deepspeed/ops/op_builder（symlink → 顶层 op_builder）检查 .so 是否已在缓存
  → 未缓存则现场调用 nvcc 编译（同样的 builder 代码）→ 缓存到 ~/.cache/deepspeed
  → deepspeed/ops/adam/fused_adam.py 加载 .so 并包装成 Python 类
```

三个 symlink 的对应关系（`ls -la` 验证）：

```text
deepspeed/accelerator      -> ../accelerator/        （顶层 accelerator/ 是真身）
deepspeed/ops/op_builder   -> ../../op_builder       （顶层 op_builder/ 是真身）
deepspeed/ops/csrc         -> ../../csrc             （顶层 csrc/ 是真身）
```

### 4.5 deepspeed/models 模型族包：一族模型一套训练定制

#### 4.5.1 概念说明

`deepspeed/models/` 是上一周期（#8659）新增的目录，确立「**模型族包（model family package）**」约定：**一个模型家族一个子包**。首个家族是 `glm_moe_dsa`——Hugging Face transformers 里 GLM-5.2（DeepSeek Sparse Attention 变体）对应的文件夹名。

为什么需要它？因为**有些训练改动只对某一个模型有意义**：为它的注意力写专用内核、替换它的某个模块、修正它的权重布局。这类代码放进通用层都不合适：

| 通用层 | 定位 | 与家族包的区别 |
|---|---|---|
| `deepspeed/ops/` | 跨模型复用的算子（fused Adam 等） | 谁都能用，不含模型知识 |
| `deepspeed/module_inject/` | 按 policy/preset **批量**注入通用机制（AutoTP/AutoEP） | 机制通用，按模型配置适配 |
| `deepspeed/models/<家族>/` | **只对这个家族有意义**的内核/模块/代码 | 别的模型不该 import 它 |

其他训练栈早有类似设计（torchtitan 的 `models/<model>/`、THUDM/slime 的插件目录）；DeepSpeed 推理侧也已有 `deepspeed/inference/v2/model_implementations/<family>/`、AutoEP 有 `module_inject/auto_ep_presets/`——**训练侧此前没有这个位置**，`deepspeed/models/` 补上了它。

约定有四条（全部写在包的 docstring 里，见 4.5.3）：子包名对齐 `transformers.models` 的文件夹名（读者从 HF 模型直达 DeepSpeed 代码，无需查表）；家族包自持所需的一切（内核、替换模块、纯 PyTorch 代码）；`import deepspeed` **不**导入这些子包，家族的可选依赖（这里是 TileLang）只由该家族的用户承担；每个子包暴露「建模后、`deepspeed.initialize` 前调用」的入口函数。

#### 4.5.2 核心流程

**（1）使用方式**：与单元 2 将学的「三步接入法」相比，家族路径只多一步——在 `deepspeed.initialize` **之前**对已建模的模型调用家族入口：

```text
通用路径:  HF 模型 ──→ deepspeed.initialize(model, config)      # 引擎按 config 启用通用机制

家族路径:  HF 模型
             └─ deepspeed.models.glm_moe_dsa.replace_attention(model)   ← 多出的一步
                  └─ deepspeed.initialize(model, config)                # 引擎照常工作；
                                                                         # 参数名/冻结模式不变
```

**（2）加载纪律**（谁付成本，谁导依赖）：

```text
import deepspeed                      → deepspeed/models/ 下什么也不执行（其 __init__.py 只有 docstring）
import deepspeed.models               → 仍不导入任何家族
import deepspeed.models.glm_moe_dsa   → 导入 attention.py（替换模块）；此时仍不需要 TileLang
   （函数体内才 from ...kernels import ... / import tilelang）
                                        → 只有真正调用 replace_attention/跑内核的用户才装 TileLang
```

这与 4.3 节的 `HAS_TRITON` 懒加载是同一思想的两种形态：**把可选成本从「所有 import 者」转移到「真正使用者」**。

#### 4.5.3 源码精读

**（1）约定本体只有 13 行**。[deepspeed/models/__init__.py:5-13](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237/deepspeed/models/__init__.py#L5-L13) 全文就是一个 docstring、零 import：

```python
"""Training changes for specific model families.

One subpackage per model family, named after the model's folder in ``transformers.models`` (for
example ``glm_moe_dsa`` for GLM-5.2). A subpackage holds whatever that family needs to train fast
or to fit in memory: kernels, replacement modules, or plain PyTorch code. ``import deepspeed`` does
not import these subpackages, so their optional dependencies are only needed by the models that
use them. Each subpackage documents the function to call on a built model before
``deepspeed.initialize``.
"""
```

一个「目录级 README」式的 `__init__.py`——4.3 节说 `__init__.py` 定义公共 API 面，这里反过来演示另一个用法：**只声明约定、不导出任何东西**，保证 `import deepspeed` 的开销为零增量。

                                                    set_context_parallel_group)

__all__ = ["DeepSpeedGlmMoeDsaAttention", "replace_attention", "set_context_parallel_group"]

**练习 1**：家族子包为什么必须叫 `glm_moe_dsa`，而不是 `glm52` 或 `ds_attention` 这样的「更好记」的名字？

**练习 2**：`deepspeed/models/` 与 `deepspeed/ops/` 都放「高性能代码」，怎么判断一段新代码该放哪边？
**答案**：问「这段代码对第二个模型有意义吗？」有意义（如 fused Adam、all-to-all 通信）放 `ops/`（或 csrc + op_builder 三件套）；只对一个家族有意义（如 GLM-5.2 的稀疏注意力内核与替换模块）放 `deepspeed/models/<家族>/`。判据是**适用范围**，不是语言或性能。

**练习 3**：为什么 `attention.py` 把 `from ...kernels import ...` 写在函数体内，而不是文件顶部？
**答案**：kernels 子包一导入就导入 TileLang。若放在顶部，`import deepspeed.models.glm_moe_dsa`（甚至任何间接 import 链）都会要求装 TileLang，「家族可选依赖只由家族用户承担」的约定就被破坏。函数内导入把依赖绑定到「真正调用内核」的时刻——与 4.3 节 `HAS_TRITON` 的模块级 `__getattr__` 异曲同工。

**练习 1**：`segment_ki.py` 放在 `module_inject/` 而不是 `models/` 某个家族包里，依据是什么？（回顾 4.5.5 练习 2 的判据。）
**答案**：它的段检测是**结构化**的——按属性名识别 `gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj` 的 GLU 家族（LLaMA/Qwen/Mistral/DeepSeek/Gemma 等都适用）与 GDN 块，不是只服务单一模型家族；按「适用范围」判据，跨模型的通用机制应住 `module_inject/`，只有单家族代码才进 `models/<家族>/`。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
